propositions: Auto-deploy container restarts during in-flight code reviews, triggering a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic reconciler recovery
The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is shorter than the review timeout (1200s), causing reviews to be cancelled mid-execution and emitting spurious fail-closed votes

Coverage-gap decisions for retryable conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should post no vote to allow reconciler backfill re-drive, while terminal conditions (indeterminate, finding) should vote -1
After N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision (default 3), a fail-closed -1 vote with exhaustion note and VOTER_ERROR metric should escalate the issue
The review_attempts ledger must be separate from voted table and support reset semantics to enable contributor re-trigger via a shared retry budget
